window_frame.note: Authored chrome. A one-point navy edge and twelve-point corner seat the Threading window without copying another platform frame.

title_bar.note: Authored chrome. The title band uses a restrained two-stop navy fill with a one-point orange active seam and a muted navy inactive seam.

window_buttons.note: Authored chrome. Shared semantic caption buttons use the plain glyph family and the title band's warm ink.

toolbar.note: Authored chrome. Application commands use the shared WindowCommandBandView directly below the title band.

buttons.note: Authored chrome. Buttons keep Threading's existing rounded control geometry and orange action color.

choice_controls.note: Authored chrome. Choice controls use the host's semantic chip treatment with Threading palette roles.

fields.note: Authored chrome. Fields use the host's semantic field surface and navy depth hierarchy.

menus.note: Authored chrome. Menus use Threading materials through the shared menu presenter.

popovers.note: Authored chrome. Popovers use the ordinary Threading material and shared presentation behavior.

scrollbars.note: Authored chrome. Scrollbars keep the automatic host behavior and resolve against the dark application appearance.

lists_tables.note: Authored chrome. Lists and tables use Threading's deep navy selection fill and warm text roles, keeping orange for actions and focus.

progress.note: Authored chrome. Progress controls use the shared continuous treatment and Threading status colors.

alerts_toasts.note: Authored chrome. Alerts and toasts use the same navy surfaces, warm text, and semantic status roles.

typography.note: Authored chrome. Threading uses the host's proportional system typography without reproducing a period face.

icons.note: Authored chrome. The title band keeps one text identity and shared semantic symbols without repeating the application icon.
